quests.title: Two From the Toxteth
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. Two of whatever's going near the Toxteth, here, hot, before the footy at first thing. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. It's Glebe; I'm not asking for much. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: pick up two from near the Toxteth
and get them here hot

quests.title: Closing Time at Jubilee Park
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. Two blokes have slept in my doorway on Jubilee Park since the pub shut. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. The Glebe delivery's at six in the morning, so get them up and show me the step empty. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: walk the two drunks off Jubilee Park
and show me the doorway clear

quests.title: The the Tramsheds Order
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. The the Tramsheds order came to seventy more than I'd budgeted and the supplier wants it by five. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Find seventy in Glebe and photograph the receipt. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: square the seventy for the the Tramsheds order
then photograph the receipt on the counter

quests.title: Something From the Tramsheds
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. The stall at the Tramsheds has run out and the customers keep coming. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. Find something round Glebe that'll do before the first thing rush. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: pick something up near the Tramsheds
bring it to the stall

quests.title: Lads Off Glebe Markets
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. Three of them in TNs on the Glebe Markets steps, flogging vapes to schoolkids at closing. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Glebe used to move them on itself and now it rings me. Do not make a scene about it.

steps.label: move the lads on from Glebe Markets

quests.title: The Glebe Markets Fence
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. My neighbour at Glebe Markets says the tree is on my side and the fence says otherwise. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. Look at it Easter Saturday with Glebe eyes and tell me the truth. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: go and look at the fence at Glebe Markets
photograph the tree over it
tell me whose side it's on

quests.title: A Flat White From Bicentennial Park
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. I want a flat white from the place near Bicentennial Park, not the one next to it. I am aware how that sounds. Here by ten past ten, while it's still coffee and Glebe still has some. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: get a flat white from the cafe near Bicentennial Park
and bring it back before it's lukewarm

quests.title: Sightline at Bicentennial Park
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. Insurance says nobody could have seen the ute hit the fence at Bicentennial Park on Friday. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Stand where I stood in Glebe, photograph the view, tell me if I'm lying. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: stand where it happened at Bicentennial Park
photograph the corner
describe the sightline

quests.title: Rent Money, the Fish Markets
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. I'm forty-five short on the the Fish Markets rent and the agent doesn't take stories. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Make it somewhere in Glebe by the last train; I'm not fussy how. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: earn forty-five somewhere in Glebe

quests.title: Bin Night, the Fish Markets
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. Somebody moves the bins on the Fish Markets in front of my drive every grand final day night. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. Photograph the evidence and have a word; Glebe knows who. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: photograph the bins at the Fish Markets
and the woman who moved them

quests.title: Staffy Near Sappho Books
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. A brindle staffy in a red bandana went over the fence at Sappho Books at the arvo. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Everyone in Glebe has definitely seen it and can't say where. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: check the off-leash bit near Sappho Books
photograph the creek end
tell me if you saw a staffy in a bandana

quests.title: The Length of the Nag's Head
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. I haven't walked the Nag's Head end to end since the light rail came to Glebe. I have rung the number on the letter four times. Do it Sunday for me and photograph what's at the far end now. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: walk the length of the Nag's Head
to the far end
photograph what's there now

quests.title: Seven a.m. At the Nag's Head
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. The site at the Nag's Head starts its jackhammer at half two on a Melbourne Cup day, which is illegal and loud. It started small, the way these things do. Photograph it running and have a word with the Glebe foreman. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: photograph the noise from the Nag's Head
and have a word with the foreman

quests.title: Counting the Toxteth
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. Council says the the Toxteth car park is never full and I say it's full by half six. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Count both Glebe car parks, photograph whichever one makes me right. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: count the cars at the Toxteth
then the other car park
photograph the fuller one
